_note: Reference crew atmospheres. Values from public NASA descriptions and the challenge brief; Mars values are an assumption (same as the exploration atmosphere).

habitats.name: Earth (sea level)
habitats.notes: Baseline. Buoyancy drives flow; ground flammability tests (e.g. NASA-STD-6001 Test 1) are done here.

habitats.name: ISS / Orion cabin
habitats.notes: Microgravity, sea-level air. Ventilation fans are the only source of flow (~5-20 cm/s).

habitats.name: Moon Base / pressurized rover
habitats.notes: Challenge brief: >=30% O2 at <=10.2 psi to shorten spacesuit pre-breathe. ~40% more O2 than Earth air.

habitats.name: Exploration atmosphere (8.2 psi / 34%)
habitats.notes: NASA Exploration Atmospheres Working Group recommendation for frequent-EVA vehicles.

habitats.name: Mars habitat (assumed)
habitats.notes: Assumed to match the exploration atmosphere; partial gravity 0.38 g.

habitats.name: Spacesuit
habitats.notes: 100% O2 at 4.3 psi. Highest O2 fraction humans breathe in exploration.
